Release PR review (Opus, read-only): blockers

Read only. No build. Head `2c57101b9`. Base `origin/main` at `6e1805bfd` (the merge base is the tip of `main`).

## Blocker

1. `CHANGELOG.md`: the "Do not touch" protection (#2055) has no row.
   - PR #2149 says `Changelog: none (the protection row shipped with #2704; ...)`.
   - The row of PR #2704 (`CHANGELOG.md:147`, `475373093`) tells only the 3D Adaptive Method choice (#1591). The Changelog line of PR #2704 does not name the protection.
   - Thus a breaking change (project v73, `RELEASE_NOTES.md:27-28` and `:127`) is not in the changelog.
   - Fix: add one row, for example `| 475373093 | 2026-11-19 | 2D Offset and 3D Pocket take "Do not touch" faces and edges: the toolpath stays clear of them, and a hit is named. Breaking: project v73 (#2055, PR #2704, PR #2149) | 0.25.0 |`. Or put the row on the PR #2149 merge `f7c36049f`.

## Checks that pass

- `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`: only the version lines change, 0.24.0 to 0.25.0. The 10 lock entries are the workspace crates (`camcraft-*`, `xtask`).
- `git diff origin/main origin/release/v0.25.0 --stat`: 230 files. These are `CHANGELOG.md`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `RECOMMENDED.md`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md` and 225 removed `docs/decisions/*.md`. There is no code change.
- `docs/decisions/` keeps only `README.md`. Each of the 225 removed files has its title in `RECOMMENDED.md`.
- `RECOMMENDED.md`: one `## v0.25.0` heading (line 58088). The diff has 11699 added lines and 0 removed lines, also without `-w`. Thus no old entry changed.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: 198 rows for 0.25.0. Each row has the skill format. I compared all 198 rows, not only 10, to the PR Changelog line, the merge commit hash and the merge date. All agree. The only differences are a dropped scope prefix (`sim:`, `wire:`) and the place of the issue numbers.
- `git log --merges --first-parent v0.24.0..origin/main`: 259 PR merges. 198 have a behaviour Changelog line, and each has a row. 61 have `none`, and none of them has a row.
- The count line (`RELEASE_NOTES.md:40-41`) agrees with the PR titles: 50 feat, 162 fix, 3 perf, 1 refactor.
- Format steps, checked with `gh pr view`: v70 PR #2092, v71 PR #2134, v72 PR #2563, v74 PR #2716 and PR #2920, v75 PR #3204. All agree with the notes. PR #2704 carried the v73 step from the earlier head of PR #2149.
- Known issues: the only open `P1`/`P2` is #3264, and the notes name it (`RELEASE_NOTES.md:190-194`). The P3 issues #1950 and #2849 are named.
- Process changes 101-122 agree with the announcements on #681.
- No closing keyword in the notes, in the PR body or in the six branch commits. #3236 is closed by PR #3263.

## Findings (not blockers)

1. `RELEASE_NOTES.md:28`: the v73 step names only PR #2704. Recommended: `(#2055, PR #2149, merged through PR #2704)`.
2. `RELEASE_NOTES.md:107` (Process changes, 107): #681 says that 107 also includes PR #2775 (the quick gate selects the tests of a changed library fixture) and PR #2704 (an MCP skill row). The line names only `cargo xtask gate heavy`.
3. `RELEASE_NOTES.md:87`: the line has 103 characters. Wrap it as the other lines.
4. PR body, "Release gate": run 44964821090 is not pending. It was cancelled at 00:05Z, before its gate step completed. Run 44965164703 is the current gate run (in progress). Write the current run ID and the re-run record.
5. PR body, "Decisions": the text says that the second `cargo xtask decisions` run changed CRLF to LF in old entries of `RECOMMENDED.md`. Against `origin/main`, the diff removes no line. Thus this change is not in the branch. Remove the sentence, or say that the change was reverted.
6. Cut list, cut line time (2026-11-21 22:16Z) and the removal of #2822 are in the body. The notes do not name #2822. This is correct.

No label set. No push. No merge.

<!-- pr-reviewer: eea778d88d5534b2c22b917bc536d07d1fd9b837 -->
Release PR re-check (Opus, read-only): clean

Read only. No build. I checked the one new commit `eea778d88` (`git diff 2c57101b9 eea778d88`) and the PR body.

## The blocker and findings of the last review

- Blocker (no row for #2055): fixed. `CHANGELOG.md:139` has the row `f7c36049f | 2026-11-19 | ... (#2055, PR #2149, PR #2704)`. `f7c36049f` is the first-parent merge of PR #2149 on `main`, with the date 2026-11-19. The file now has 199 rows for 0.25.0.
- Finding 1: fixed. `RELEASE_NOTES.md:28` names PR #2149, merged through PR #2704.
- Finding 2: fixed. Process change 107 names PR #2775 and PR #2704 (`RELEASE_NOTES.md:212-214`).
- Finding 3: fixed. No line in the 0.25.0 notes has more than 80 characters.
- Finding 4: fixed. The "Release gate" section records the cancelled runs and their reasons.
- Finding 5: fixed. The body says that no old entry of `RECOMMENDED.md` changed.

## Other checks

- Compared with `main`, the branch changes the same five files as before, plus the removed decision files. There is no code change.
- The commit has no closing keyword.

## Notes (not blockers)

1. `RELEASE_NOTES.md:90`: the line `(#3213). Work outside the stated` is short. The paragraph can be wrapped again. This is cosmetic.
2. The release gate result is pending. The PR body says that it runs locally on Windows, on head `eea778d88`, because no Linux runner is online. This is the fallback of the `release-cut` skill. The tag must be on exactly this tree: do not push to the branch after the gate.

No label set. No push. No merge.

Coordinator: the release gate is green on the exact head eea778d88 (local fallback, 1333 steps, 0 failed). The review that this merge relies on is the re-check on head eea778d88 (comment 7071641266, clean). `main` is 6e1805bfd, an ancestor of this head, so nothing merged to `main` after the gated tree. I merge this PR on head eea778d88. Nothing is pushed after this comment. The tag is made by hand on the merge commit, only if `git diff eea778d88 <merge>` is empty.
